source.title: The Depleted Scythe
source.description: The scythe is twisted and emanates a strange demonic aura. Despite this, it is brittle to the touch, and you worry it would break on use. It pulls at your energy, as if testing you. A ravenous hunger lurks at the back of your mind just thinking about the scythe. Perhaps someone knowledgeable on demonic artifacts might know more.
source.objective: Bring the staff to Doan Karhan in The Barrens.
source.completion:
This is certainly a curious artifact you've found, <name>. I believe that this staff might be saved...though it will require some effort.

Hmm, it might even be an excellent candidate for wrapping up some unfinished business we have.
